editions.name: TiddlyWiki Forge (landingswiki)
editions.description: Bilingual Forge homepage with editable ABC Jingle follow-score card, plugin library and standalone wiki download

home.headingEn: Keep your own copy of this page
home.descriptionDa: Forge-forsiden med en interaktiv Jingle og redigerbare noder.
home.descriptionEn: Forge landing wiki with an interactive Jingle and editable music notation.
home.noteDa: Biblioteker og nye downloads kræver internet.
home.noteEn: Libraries and new downloads require internet access.

editions.name: Graph Edition (beta)
editions.description: Graph Edition using native TW5-Graph add-node/add-edge toolbar buttons and compact contextual editing for relations and appearance.

home.descriptionDa: Brug de originale Add Node og Add Edge-knapper i grafen, og klik på en node for at ændre udseende. Ingen permanent konfigurator.
home.descriptionEn: Use the original Add Node and Add Edge buttons in the graph, and click a node to change its appearance. No persistent editor.
home.noteDa: Beta: Et lille panel åbnes kun ved node, forbindelse eller udseende. Både mus og touch-simulering testet; fysisk iPad-test mangler.
home.noteEn: Beta: A compact panel opens only when editing a node, edge or appearance. Mouse and simulated touch tested; physical iPad check pending.

editions.name: HUPedia Edition
editions.description: HUPedia: readable editable WikiText, Danish/English infoboxes and article translations using TiddlyWiki's language

home.descriptionDa: Saml artikler, faktabokse og kilder i dit eget opslagsværk.
home.descriptionEn: Build your own reference library of articles, fact boxes and sources.
home.noteDa: Artikelvisning og sprog er stadig under afprøvning.
home.noteEn: Article display and language support are still being tested.

editions.name: Tegne Edition (test)
editions.description: Offline Excalidraw drawing studio with editable SVG scenes, SitePublisher and bilingual UI; large self-contained file; browser test pending

home.descriptionDa: Tegn med Excalidraw, gem redigerbare scener og udgiv som HTML.
home.descriptionEn: Draw with Excalidraw, keep editable scenes and publish to HTML.
home.noteDa: Stor HTML-fil. Mac- og iPad-accept udestår.
home.noteEn: Large HTML file. Mac and iPad acceptance is pending.

editions.name: Musik Edition (test)
editions.description: ABC notation with editable score, responsive three-tab mini mixer (Voices, Accompaniment, Chords), live playback controls, TinySynth offline fallback, MuseScore import and teaching collections

home.descriptionDa: Skriv ABC-noder, importer fra MuseScore, og afspil TiddlyWiki Jingle med flytbar mixer og akkorder, der følger musikken.
home.descriptionEn: Write ABC notation, import from MuseScore, and play the TiddlyWiki Jingle with a detachable mixer and follow-along chord chart.
home.noteDa: ABC 0.3.38-test.4 · tre mixerfaner · diskret akkordzoom −/+ · TinySynth offline-reserve.
home.noteEn: ABC 0.3.38-test.4 · three mixer tabs · discreet chord zoom −/+ · offline TinySynth backup.

editions.name: SilbaÄtno Repertoire
editions.description: 17 ABC-noder, Repertoire-nodebog med fælles fuldskærmsvisning, sætlistenavigation og Music Minus One

home.descriptionDa: Åbn direkte i en fuldskærmsnodebog med én/to sider, søgbar nummerliste, øvetilstand og gennemgående bladring mellem melodier.
home.descriptionEn: Open a full-screen music book with one/two pages, searchable setlist, practice mode and seamless turning between tunes.
home.noteDa: Beta · ny fuldskærmsvisning – fysisk iPad-test mangler; kontrollér notation og gentagelser.
home.noteEn: Beta · new fullscreen reader; physical iPad testing pending. Check notation and repeats.

editions.name: AniMus Forge I (beta)
editions.description: Start your own animation from a blank scene or a starter template. Open complete example productions separately.

home.descriptionDa: Start med en tom scene eller en startpakke. Åbn de færdige forestillinger fra værkstedets galleri.
home.descriptionEn: Start with a blank stage or a starter template. Open complete productions separately from the workshop gallery.
home.noteDa: Meget tidlig beta: motor og eksempler kan ændres uden garanti for dine data. iPad-lyd er ikke godkendt. Forslag og fejlmeldinger er velkomne på Talk og GitHub.
home.noteEn: Very early beta: core and examples may change without preserving your edits. iPad audio is unverified. Feedback welcome on Talk and GitHub.

editions.name: Turn Around — Beyond the Cave
editions.description: An AI-generated musical animation made with AniMus. Explore Plato’s cave, then edit the audio recordings, music, characters, camera and animation.

home.headingDa: En AniMus-musical, du kan arbejde videre med
home.headingEn: An AniMus musical to watch and remake
home.descriptionDa: AI-genereret animation skabt med AniMus: Platons hule som musical. Se og redigér forestillingen, og hent video, lydspor og undertekster.
home.descriptionEn: An AI-generated animation made with AniMus: Plato’s cave as a musical. Watch and edit the performance, then download video, audio tracks and captions.
home.noteDa: Engelsk lyd og lip-sync med 103 danske eller engelske undertekster. 14 scener, ABC-partiturer og indlejrede lydoptagelser.
home.noteEn: English audio and lip-sync with 103 captions in Danish or English. 14 scenes, ABC scores and embedded audio.

editions.name: The Ship of Theseus
editions.description: A fourteen-scene musical with Mara, Pip and Ione, in Danish and English.

home.descriptionDa: En musical i 14 scener med Mara, Pip og Ione om skibet, træet og det, vi bærer videre.
home.descriptionEn: A fourteen-scene musical with Mara, Pip and Ione about the ship, its timber and what we carry forward.
home.noteDa: Dansk og engelsk tale · to sange på hvert sprog · redigér i AniMus.
home.noteEn: Danish and English dialogue · two songs in each language · editable in AniMus.

editions.name: AI Edition (test)
editions.description: AI Forge 0.4.2 with OpenAI, Claude and Google Gemini, local LM Studio/Ollama, approved ForgeShare Vault and screenshot analysis.

home.headingDa: Samtaler, AI-opgaver og dine egne modeller
home.headingEn: AI conversations, tasks and your models
home.descriptionDa: Brug OpenAI, Claude, Gemini eller en lokal AI-model via LM Studio/Ollama. ForgeShare er valgfri.
home.descriptionEn: Use OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or local models via LM Studio/Ollama. ForgeShare is optional.
home.noteDa: Testudgave: Gemini via ForgeShare kræver hjælperen 0.1.19 til Mac, Windows eller Linux og godkendelse. Direkte cloud-kald kan blokeres af CORS.
home.noteEn: Test release: Gemini via ForgeShare needs the 0.1.19 helper for Mac, Windows or Linux and approval. Direct browser cloud requests may be blocked by CORS.

editions.name: HUPin Edition (test)
editions.description: Interactive pins on images and SVG; optional PasteUp and online map integrations. English UI migration pending / Klikbare billeder og SVG

home.descriptionDa: Sæt klikbare punkter på billeder og SVG og forbind dem med dine tekster.
home.descriptionEn: Add clickable hotspots to images and SVG and connect them to your notes.
home.noteDa: Engelsk brugerflade er endnu ikke færdig.
home.noteEn: The English interface is not yet complete.

editions.name: Demo Edition
editions.description: Minimal test af TiddlyWiki-plugin og før-boot-indlæsning.

home.descriptionDa: En lille wiki til at prøve Forge, redigering og lokal gemning.
home.descriptionEn: A small wiki for trying Forge, editing and local saving.

editions.name: CutOut Edition (test)
editions.description: Original CutOut workshop, examples, Excalidraw drawing bridge, scenes, theatre, PasteUp and Slideshow; local export and native Dansk/English

home.descriptionDa: Byg dukker, tegn dele og skab animationer, scener og forestillinger. De oprindelige eksempler følger med.
home.descriptionEn: Build puppets, draw parts and create animations, scenes and performances. Includes the original examples.
home.noteDa: Afprøvet i Chrome på computer. Mobil/touch er endnu ikke accepteret.
home.noteEn: Tested in desktop Chrome. Mobile/touch acceptance is pending.

editions.name: Slideshow Edition (test)
editions.description: Original Slideshow and PasteUp, seven example stories, local document import, PDF, interactive sites and editable wiki backup; native Dansk/English

home.descriptionDa: Giv dine tiddlere en scene. Brug PasteUp, syv fortællinger og lokal dokumentimport som begyndelse.
home.descriptionEn: Give your tiddlers a stage. Start with PasteUp, seven stories or a locally imported document.
home.noteDa: Visuel Office-import kræver valgfri lokal LibreOffice-hjælper eller en PDF. Mobil/touch udestår.
home.noteEn: Visual Office import uses an optional local LibreOffice helper or a PDF. Mobile/touch testing is pending.

editions.name: Shop Edition (test)
editions.description: Nine original Shop templates, offline customer-site export and a manual Forms/Sheets, Google Sites and Funnel setup guide

home.headingDa: Din egen butik, trin for trin
home.headingEn: Your own shop, step by step
home.descriptionDa: Lav et Shop Site og følg opsætningen af formular, ordreark og udgivelse. Ni skabeloner følger med.
home.descriptionEn: Create a Shop Site and follow the form, order sheet and publishing setup. Includes nine templates.
home.noteDa: Testudgave. Google Sites, prøveordre til privat Sheets-ark og offentlig Funnel afprøvet på computer. Fysisk mobiltest udestår.
home.noteEn: Test edition. Google Sites, a test order into a private Sheet and public Funnel verified on desktop. Physical mobile testing remains pending.
